title: claude-settings guard cull: two possible false alarms
why: A guard that refuses when nothing is wrong teaches the reader to scroll past it (rule verification-cry-wolf-guard-is-spent).
note: Feedback for claude-settings, which the owner carries. From lane duo-gaps-design-review, 2026-11-08: (1) worktree-home refused a resumed reviewer's read-only git in the lane checkout; (2) env-file refused a CSS selector `.env` in a design file. Weigh both at the next cull.
